'''Waryl's Fangs''' were modified [[Royal Yvarema scout ship]]s constructed by the [[Yvarema]] after encountering the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]''. The ships were modified under the supervision of [[Gunthar]] and [[Qesya Vth'naar]]. The vessels were armed with a [[Navigation deflector system|navigational deflector]] designed to clear space dust while traveling through the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] but which could be employed as a makeshift weapon when needed. Under Vth'naar's direction, primitive [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] were fitted to the ship, alongside a single [[Fusion missile|tactical fusion missile]].

A fleet of ten Waryl's Fangs were deployed to assist the ''FarStar'' during the [[Battle of Kathol System]] against the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
